title: Translate the internal instruction-surface stock to Chinese (`.claude/skills/**`) — machine anchors stay English; customer `skills/**` untouched
body:
Maintainer direct-command card, filed and claimed by the skills seat (session `session_017TNzEetykdh7ceZGwuAPLq`). Provenance (2026-08-16, live PM session, verbatim, untranslated):

> 我建议存量你一次性处理为中文。

> .claude/skills/** 用中文，给客户的 skills 不要改。

Context ruling from the same discussion: internal instruction text defaults to Chinese for maintainer review speed; the seat's analysis (model-comprehension impact negligible, token delta small and bidirectional, review-accuracy gain dominant) is on the session record. Accepted alongside: machine anchors stay English; published `skills/**` stays English.

## Scope — wave 1a (this card's first PR, dispatched now)

Translate narrative prose to Chinese, **semantics-preserving only** (no rule changes; where the English is ambiguous, preserve the ambiguity or flag it in the PR body — never resolve it silently). Files and per-file ratchet ceilings (from `origin/main`):

| file | lines (= ceiling) |
|---|---|
| `.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md` | 61 |
| `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` | 137 |
| `.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md` | 157 |
| `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` | 389 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/compile-surfaces.md` | 26 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 216 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md` | 82 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` | 121 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md` | 82 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` | 101 |

## Exclusions and later waves

- ⛔ `skills/**` (published, customer-facing) — untouched, per the ruling.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — already Chinese-dominant; its residual English fragments are **wave 2**, after the in-flight wave-checkpoint PR and the queued claim-section card clear the hot-file queue.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — **wave 1b**, after the contract-fix bundle (in flight) lands, so the bundle's semantic diff and the translation's language diff stay separately reviewable.

## Invariants (binding)

- **Machine anchors stay English, byte-stable**: frontmatter blocks; label names (`pm:queue`, `finding`, …); commands, script names, gate names (`check:*`), file paths, globs; JSON report-contract keys and enum values (`premise_still_valid`, `status: done | rework | blocked | needs_decision`, …); the literal `Claim:` first-line predicate; `<!-- os-dev-report -->`; `Fixes #<n>` / `Part of #<n>` forms; tool and product names. Commands inside code blocks untranslated (comments inside them may translate).
- **Verbatim quotes stay verbatim** in whatever language they are.
- **Per-file ratchet**: net non-increasing per file (Chinese is denser — shrink is expected and welcome; ⛔ no padding).
- `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (no issue numbers in operational text) must stay clean; the decision-frame copies (`references/review-checklist.md`) must stay structurally isomorphic (`check:skill-frame-sync` / `-freshness` green).
- Terminology must match `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`'s established Chinese vocabulary (认领/派发/复核/定级/座位贴/在飞/门禁/棘轮/回队/交接…).

## Delivery

One draft PR per wave, `Part of` this card (the card closes after wave 2). `skip-changeset` (`.claude/`-only). **ADR-class: human merge only** — the maintainer's merge is the veto window. PR prose in English with the provenance quotes above; every translation judgment call listed in the PR body.
